probe_result: A timeout that replays without new evidence is falsified: in two hidden-applied/uncertain symbolic cases it duplicates an already-applied effect. Indefinite DEFER preserves safety but cannot restore progress. Evidence-epoch renewal passes for conditional safety and conditional liveness in the tested serialized single-writer cut: lease expiry only invalidates the old observation; a newly fresh same-effect certificate may authorize SKIP/RECOVER when applied or one REPLAY when fresh-absent, while uncertain or identity-mismatched evidence remains DEFER.
neuroscience_transfer: Reliability-gated corollary-discharge analogy: decay of confidence in an old reafference comparison should trigger reacquisition of evidence, not invert the action conclusion. Expired evidence becomes unknown rather than opposite.
mechanism_revision: Lease/timeout expiry is an evidence invalidation event, never an action authorization event. Renewal advances an evidence epoch; replay/skip stays gated by newly fresh effect-identity-fenced observation.
scope_guard: Positive claim is limited to serialized single-writer symbolic cases with durable intent, deterministic effect identity, and truthful freshness/identity certificates. No claim for concurrent writers, falsely certified stale observations, target corruption, nondeterministic ids, distributed consensus, or exactly-once liveness when fresh decisive target observation is unavailable.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: bounded role-local persistence/readback only; no hosted compute or repository API volume used as computation
mechanism_assessment.accepted_scope: DEFER-branch recurrence safety: expiry invalidates evidence only; fresh identity-fenced evidence required before replay/skip
mechanism_assessment.unresolved_child: Exactly-once liveness remains unresolved when Chat-native observable target state cannot provide a newly fresh decisive same-effect observation.
